title: Design System: Castle — Камень и время

title.purpose: Real castle names in gallery captions.

body.purpose: Supporting frame copy and compact controls.

label.purpose: Uppercase annotations around the photographic field.

shadows.name: intro-text
shadows.purpose: Intro copy contrast shadow; no surface elevation.

motion.name: hero-tag
motion.purpose: Brighten fill and translate upward by 3px on hover.

motion.name: indicator
motion.purpose: Inactive vertical stroke scale .58, active scale 1.

motion.name: scroll-follow
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll-derived split hero and overlapping gallery.

motion.name: split-hero
motion.purpose: Matching transparent castle halves separate at a 50% clip boundary; transform origin 50% 65%.

motion.name: gallery-overlap
motion.purpose: In each independent gallery, incoming frames cover predecessors from right to left in one viewport; covered frames drift left up to 7%. Shared paintGallery logic, separate selection and controls.

motion.name: background-wipe
motion.purpose: Reveal the matching background from right to left with foreground incoming progress.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable CSS transitions and hero transforms, immediate navigation and discrete gallery selection; opacity changes remain. Hero remains stationary on pointer movement in every mode.

motion.name: portal-travel
motion.purpose: Reversible scroll passage through a native alpha stone gateway; foreground grows from 1 to 5.2 around 50% 65%, landscape settles from 1.12 to 1 around 50% 60%. Uses the existing .15 scroll interpolation; no pointer response or scroll lock.

motion.name: portal-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Static arch and landscape with screen-reader-only heading and persistent attribution in one 100svh section. Transform hints are disabled; normal mode enables hints only near the section.
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; image transform:none!important; will-change:auto!important; section height:100svh

narrative.overview:
The user's pinned Mostar and Saisei references establish oversized cream Ogg lettering, cinematic photography and scroll choreography. The supplied 2048 × 1536 hero photograph transitions into transparent left/right tower halves that separate outward to reveal other real castles.

The mood is quiet, spacious and cinematic. Нойшванштайн, Эйлен-Донан and Шильон appear in a shared portrait viewport: each incoming photo covers the preceding one while its matching full-screen background wipes into view. Russian captions include photographer and license links.

A full-bleed arch passage has a screen-reader-only heading and visible landscape attribution. Its continuation reuses the same gallery language for Гогенцоллерн, Мон-Сен-Мишель and Алькасар Сеговии with independent controls and separate sourced backgrounds.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized serif display type over photography
Equivalent scroll, keyboard, button and swipe navigation

rules.name: The Landscape Background Rule
rules.body: Keep the foreground castle photos unchanged. Use separate approved Alpsee, Loch Duich sunset and Lake Geneva backgrounds, with synchronized wipes and a visible photographer/license credit.

rules.name: The Typeface Role Rule
rules.body: Ogg carries Latin display, Georgia carries Russian editorial headings, Arial carries interface copy.
Keep gallery images stacked in one clipped viewport with a common size and 112px caption region; incoming imagery covers the previous frame.
rules.name: The Shared Frame Rule

dos: Do preserve the pinned reference direction, cream typography and spacious photography
Do use the supplied high-resolution castle and aligned transparent halves for the opening
Do use other real sourced castles with visible photo credits
Do synchronize foreground overlap and matching background wipes
Do preserve Russian copy, focus visibility, equivalent controls and responsive/reduced-motion behavior
donts: Don't restore repeated crops from the supplied hero photo
Don't turn the gallery into a side-by-side strip or round its frames
Don't invent historical claims, castle identities or photo provenance
Don't introduce an unrelated identity or raised cards
